description: This file defines the JsonStringMatcher class, which extends BodyMatcher<String> and provides JSON string matching functionality with detailed difference reporting, using Jackson and jsonunit libraries.

classes.name: JsonStringMatcher
classes.description: A class for matching JSON strings with configurable match types and detailed difference reporting, extending BodyMatcher<String>.

classes.name: Difference
classes.description: Inner class implementing DifferenceListener to collect differences during JSON comparison.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Performs JSON string matching against a matcher with optional strictness, reporting differences via a context.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher string is blank.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Method of Difference class to process differences during JSON comparison.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Converts a value to a pretty-printed JSON string or fallback to toString.
